coverage: Whole group totals; no product-level profit allocation
incomeDefinition: Interest earned plus other income, including insurance premium and other operating income from insurance businesses. This is gross group income before interest expense, insurance claims, operating expenses and provisions; it is not sales or net interest income.
definition: Consolidated net profit after tax, share of associates where applicable, and deduction of profit attributable to minority shareholders. Minority shareholders own stakes in group subsidiaries; their earnings are excluded from this profit figure.
location: PDF and printed page 11 · consolidated financial results, FY2026 annual column, rows 1–3 and 11–17
notes: Consolidated total income includes insurance subsidiaries and therefore differs from standalone bank income. PAT before minority shareholders is ₹57,936.25 crore; the displayed owners’ PAT deducts ₹3,728.55 crore. This does not identify the profit of an individual account, card or loan product. Compare funding, credit costs and capital separately rather than treating PAT divided by total income as a product margin.
insight: Insurance income is a substantial part of group total income and has corresponding claims and expenses. To understand lending profitability, examine the standalone bank’s net interest income and provisions alongside these group totals.
